Hi Sean —

Thanks for taking our call this morning. Per our conversation, I attached the Certificate of Insurance and a completed W-9. We can also provide an additional insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." and we are able to list Redwood as Certificate Holder. One question from your team: for subcontractors, we work with a small set of vetted partners (listed in the endorsement draft) — is that sufficient, or do you need a full subcontractor schedule?

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@upliftsys.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: COI and onboarding docs attached

Looping you all in — forwarding Uplift's initial packet. Quick checklist request:

- Marissa: can procurement confirm whether Redwood can accept an endorsement that names us as Additional Insured "as respects the operations, products and completed operations of the named insured"? We typically prefer a broader endorsement but may accept narrower language depending on SOW risk.
- Stephanie: can vendor activation hold a conditional PO if Uplift provides the signed endorsement and a short subcontractor list? We'd like to avoid delaying their kickoff but need to track the endorsement clearance in the PO notes.
- Priyom: if you can flag any legal redlines in the endorsement draft and confirm whether we require waiver of subrogation or a separate DOL/retroactive date clause.

Carlos — thanks for sending. If you can prep the endorsement draft and a doc with the subcontractor names (even a short list), that will help us move to a conditional PO while we finish review.

Sean
Senior Vendor Manager
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: COI and onboarding docs attached

Thanks for the ping, Sean. I reviewed the attached COI and W-9. Short notes:

- COI shows required limits, carrier not on our exclusion list.
- We can issue a conditional PO for up to 30 days pending receipt of a signed Additional Insured Endorsement and the subcontractor list. We'll add the clause in the PO comments that activation is contingent on final endorsement review.
- For the endorsement language: Procurement prefers broad Additional Insured wording but will accept the "as respects" limited endorsement if Legal confirms it covers completed operations.

I've attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (example fields you'll see in PO setup). Carlos, when you send the endorsement draft, please include: effective date, endorsement form number, and if possible a short table of subcontractors (company name + service). That will let us mark which subcontracts need separate checks.

If Legal wants the endorsement redlined, Priyom — could you please review and return by EOD tomorrow? We have a soft project start target next Monday and it would be helpful to get the PO in draft today.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead, Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Per the requests: attached is the endorsement draft (Uplift_Endorsement_Draft.pdf) that names "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured with completed operations coverage and includes a short subcontractor table (3 vendors) in Appendix A. We cannot provide an unconditional waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood across all policy lines, but the carrier will include a limited waiver where allowed — language is in the draft.

I included a DocuSign envelope if you want to sign electronically: https://app.docusign.com/some-long-id-EXAMPLE . If legal wants changes, send redlines and we'll route internally.
